{{Quote|Some hotshot Imperial Moff or admiral is stirring the pot way over in Bozhnee sector, and Ackbar's been shuffling forces like crazy to try and box him in somewhere.|[[Unidentified New Republic admiral|The commander]] of the task force assigned to liberate the planet Kal'Shebbol, to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], three days before heading out to Bozhnee sector|<ref name="tsb">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>}}
The '''Bozhnee sector''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Bordering several other [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]&mdash;including the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra]], [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda]], [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema]], [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar]], [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex]] and [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sectors]]&mdash;the Bozhnee sector boasted at least six [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that called [[Planet/Legends|planets]] within its borders home. One area of the sector, known as the [[Ninth Quadrant]], had been part of the neighboring [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region until it was stripped from the rule of the region's [[Ancient Houses]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] several centuries before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

An unimportant region of space, the Bozhnee sector survived various [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] wars relatively unscathed. The planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], however, was the site of an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] built by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] which was commandeered by the Galactic Republic during the [[Great Galactic War]] to house [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] prisoners. The planet was later host to a secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] enclave that sheltered [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] hiding from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the wake of the galaxy-wide purge of Jedi known as [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The enclave was [[Attack on Belsavis|destroyed]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] by Imperial forces, although the majority of the [[Children of the Jedi|refugees]] escaped the planet. Several [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in the region had ties to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], including the [[Garnib system/Legends|Garnib]], [[Ossel system/Legends|Ossel]], and [[Brodogon system/Legends|Brodogon systems]]. In the case of both the Garnib and Ossel systems, this was a holdover from the time when the Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region controlled the Ninth Quadrant&mdash;in which these planets were found&mdash;and exploited the native populations for slave labor.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Bozhnee sector was a source of contention between the remnants of the Empire and the fledgling [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] deployed elements of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military]] to the sector in an effort to foil the strategic moves of an Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] or admiral attempting to stir up trouble in the region. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Belsavis was the site of an [[Ismaren plot|attempt]] by former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]] to reconstitute the Empire with her son, [[Irek Ismaren|Irek]], at the head. The plot was foiled by the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and her husband, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

==Description==
The Bozhnee [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], in the region known as the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="TEA" /> It bordered the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra]], [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda]], [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema]],<ref name="Outer Rim Extra">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar sectors]],<ref name="Inner Rim Extra">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> as well as the [[Ninth Quadrant]], a region that was under the control of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]]&mdash;an autonomous area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by a cadre of [[Ancient Houses]]&mdash;until the Quadrant was forcibly taken by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and placed within the borders of the Bozhnee sector. With its new territory, the Bozhnee sector's boundaries extended to abut both the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]] and [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sectors]]. At least three [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] passed through the Bozhnee sector&mdash;the [[Velga Route]], which started in the Juvex sector in the [[Velga system/Legends|Velga system]]; the [[Anturi Reach]], which connected the Senex sector to the [[Nothoiin Corridor]]; and the [[Belsavis Run]], which connected the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in the Bozhnee sector to the planet [[Tekurr'k]] in the Senex sector. Stellar phenomenon in the area included the [[Greeb-Streebling Cluster/Legends|Greeb-Streebling Cluster]], which was a mass of dust and [[Protostar/Legends|protostars]], and [[The Noopiths/Legends|the Noopiths]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Belsavis-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|The planet Belsavis]]
The Bozhnee sector contained a myriad of planets and star systems, several of which were home to [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The most prominent planet was the icy world of Belsavis, which sat at the end of the Belsavis Run, and exported [[vine-coffee]] and [[vine-silk]]. Settlements on Belsavis were located in volcanic valleys, although they were sealed in domes to protect them from the frigid climate.<ref name="CoJ" /> Tens of thousands of years prior to [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] ruled a large portion of galaxy. Belsavis was one of the planets under their control, and the Empire established a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on its surface that housed the most dangerous prisoners in the galaxy, secured within vaults and [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis fields]]. Although the Infinite Empire eventually fell, the prison remained. Around fifty years prior to the outbreak of the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="TOR-Belsavis">{{Holonet|planets|belsavis|Belsavis}}</ref> in [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> the Galactic Republic discovered the prison with the inmates still contained. The Republic stationed forces on the planet in an effort to contain any threat the inmates posed once the containment systems inevitably failed, and established a new Republic prison known as "[[The Tomb]]" on the surface. During the Great Galactic War, The Tomb was used to incarcerate captured [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]]. Although the Republic attempted to keep the location of the prison secret, [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] discovered the information, prompting the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to send ground forces to the planet in an attempt to free their imprisoned brethren resulting in pitched battles being fought in and around the prison.<ref name="TOR-Belsavis" /> Thousands of years later, Belsavis was home to a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species known as the [[Mluki]], and&mdash;following the [[Great Jedi Purge]] in the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;became a temporary refuge to [[Children of the Jedi|Jedi younglings]] who survived the massacre of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="CoJ" />

Two planets, [[Garnib]] and [[Ossel II]], were originally located in the Ninth Quadrant,<ref name="TEA" /> and were used by the [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] of the Senex-Juvex to procure [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] species to be used throughout their holdings. With the forced annexation of the Quadrant by the Republic, the native species&mdash;the [[Balinaka]] and the [[Ossan]]s respectively&mdash;came under Republic authority, although slave-breeding [[Farm/Legends|farms]] had been established on other worlds within the Senex and Juvex sectors.<ref name="CoJ" /> Garnib was another icy planet, and its main export was the highly prized, and possibly addictive, [[Garnib crystal]]s. Run by the [[Galactic Crystal Creations|Garnib Crystal Corporation]], the world was a haven for [[Artist/Legends|artists]] from all over the galaxy. Garnib was also the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Vernol, who emigrated to the planet in large numbers after their own [[Vernol homeworld|homeworld]] was rendered uninhabitable. With the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Garnib came under Imperial rule.<ref name="PoG1" /> The planets [[Hultomo]], [[Mastala]], and [[Coomputu]] were also located within the [[Garnib system/Legends|Garnib system]].<ref name="PoG1" /> Mastala later [[Mastala (DP20 gunship)|lent its name]] to a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="TBSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> Ossel II was a swampy, high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] world that exported [[syp wood]]. The native Ossans regularly traded the syp wood for indentured service aboard [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] vessels, refusing to take any other form of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] or barter.<ref name="AE" />

[[Jankok]] was a warm planet that was home to the [[Srrors'tok]] species. Technologically primitive, the Srrors'tok lived in tribal hunting clans and employed an honor system that was akin to the [[Life debt/Legends|life debts]] made famous by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="AE" /> The [[Sibilaar system/Legends|Sibilaar system]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> was once the location of the [[Sibilaari homeworld|homeworld]] of the [[Sibilaari]]. The planet underwent a [[Destruction of the Sibilaari homeworld|cataclysm]] that destroyed the planet at some time, although the Sibilaari managed to survive by building shelters in the most stable parts of their world. When the planet was destroyed, large chunks of the planet survived, many with shelters containing Sibilaari safely ensconced within.<ref name="Philanthropy" /> The sector was also the location of the [[Brodogon system/Legends|Brodogon system]],<ref name="TEA-OC" /> which had ties to the slaving organization known as the [[Brodogon Consortium]].<ref name="Jedi Quest">[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest (comic series)|''Jedi Quest'']]</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
Located in the Outer Rim Territories, the Bozhnee sector originally bordered the Ninth Quadrant, a region of space on the edge of the Senex and Juvex sectors. The region had been annexed by the ruling Ancient Houses of the region in [[700 BBY]] to provide a buffer zone against the creeping [[Politics/Legends|political]] and industrial influence emanating from the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] that threatened to end their self-imposed isolation from the Republic. It was named the Ninth Quadrant since the original territories claimed by the Houses of the Senex-Juvex had been eight in number, four in each of the Senex and Juvex sectors. In the century following the marriage of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Osted Picutorion]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Farasa Anturi]]&mdash;deranged heir to one of the weaker Senex houses&mdash;in [[553 BBY]], the Senex-Juvex region underwent several internal changes as the Houses realized that their isolationist nature had led them to fall behind the wider galaxy technologically. The alliance between Picutorion and [[House Picutorion|House Anturi]] led them to defeat the combined forces of Houses [[House Vandron|Vandron]] and [[House Petro|Petro]], free the [[Hutlarian]]s from slavery, and occupy the planet [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]]. With the so-called "[[Crimson Days]]" of conflict at an end, the Senex-Juvex had to deal with several crises. [[House Mekuun]], noted for its rebellious nature, dissolved itself with the intent of reconstituting its holdings as a Republic sector and&mdash;more damagingly&mdash;the Republic was able to forcibly strip the Ninth Quadrant from the Senex-Juvex region, integrating it into the Bozhnee sector. However, the Houses of the Senex-Juvex still considered the Ninth Quadrant and its worlds to be part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], while official listings assigned the region to the Outer Rim Territories. [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]] continued to use the term "Ninth Quadrant" to refer to the area.<ref name="TEA" />

At some point, the homeworld of the Sibilaari underwent a catastrophe. Although the species was warned of danger through their inherent connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], they lacked the technology to leave their planet. Instead, they built shielded chambers in the most stable parts of the planet and retreated into these safe havens. When the planet was destroyed, large chunks of the crust were thrown into space, many carrying comatose Sibilaari secured within the shielded areas. These chunks drifted through the galaxy with their dormant charges; at least one was discovered in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Philanthropy" />

[[File:PlettsHouse-TEGtPaM.png|right|thumb|The house of Jedi Master Plett on Belsavis was targeted for destruction by the Empire for housing Jedi younglings following Order 66.]]
Around [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]], a wave of immigration brought a large number of [[Vernol]]s to settle on the planet Garnib. Their own homeworld had been rendered uninhabitable by a [[Meteor/Legends|meteor]] strike, and they regarded Garnib as a safe, secure place to live. The native Balinaka allowed them to stay, although the two groups had limited contact.<ref name="AE" />

===A time of conflict===
During the Clone Wars, the Bozhnee sector was inside Republic-controlled space.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HoloNet">{{InsiderCite|73|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:13}}</ref> shortly after the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]], Republic forces organized a mass evacuation of the citizens of the planet [[Argul]],<ref name="Only the Force">"[[Only the Force]]"</ref> located in the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The rendezvous point for the evacuation [[Transport/Legends|transports]] was located near Belsavis.<ref name="Only the Force" /> However, by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Belsavis was considered an undecided world with no allegiance to either the Republic or the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Clone War Worlds">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

In the final days of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;who was, in actuality, a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] plotting the downfall of the Republic and Jedi Order&mdash;declared [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which stated that all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were traitors to the Republic and were to be terminated on sight. The Jedi had led the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as its senior commanders, and the majority of Jedi were killed across the galaxy by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that they commanded in battle, although some managed to flee into hiding.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> A group of refugees, mainly [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], headed to Belsavis, where the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plett]] had lived for some seventy years. Despite the younglings being under Plett's protection, the Empire learned of the enclave in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Originally, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine commissioned a battlemoon, the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'', to destroy the refuge. However, the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was stopped by a pair of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] in the [[Moonflower Nebula/Legends|Moonflower Nebula]]. A [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] [[Attack on Belsavis|assaulted]] the enclave as a contingency, but the attack only caused minimal damage and the refugees were able to escape.<ref name="CoJ" />

[[File:Garnib1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A city on the planet Garnib]]
During the reign of the Empire, Garnib came under Imperial rule. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Verus Carbinol]] was responsible for running the planet, and the native Balinaka put up no resistance to their new Imperial masters. They saw little point in waging armed conflict against an enemy they could not defeat, so they continued to live their lives as they had always done and paid their taxes on time. For the most part, the Imperial presence on the planet was low key; it was considered a safe and easy posting.<ref name="PoG1" /> Despite the Balinaka's pacifism, an anti-Imperial movement did take root on the planet. During the Galactic Civil War, these fighters attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Gam Rothwall]]&mdash;an [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] who had ordered the kidnapping and execution of several important Garnib Crystal Corporation officials&mdash;during a surprise inspection tour to the world.<ref name="Relative">{{WEGCite|story=Relative Difficulties|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen}}</ref> The Empire also exploited Garnib for slave labor,<ref name="TEA" /> placing it in the company of worlds such as [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]] and [[Trosh]].<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>

Following the death of Emperor Palpatine at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref> the Empire fragmented as senior officials rushed to fill the power vacuum and established warlord empires. For at least two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Bozhnee sector came under the control of [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]]'s [[Eriadu Authority]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Bozhnee sector was a point of contention between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the remnants of the Empire. During the Republic's campaign to bring several Imperial warlord empires to heel, a senior Imperial official&mdash;tentatively identified as holding the rank of either [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] or [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]&mdash;began to stir up trouble in the region. With limited assets available to him, Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], [[Supreme Commander]] of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]], was forced to shuffle his task forces to box the Imperial official in and counter the threat. The [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|task force]] that had been assigned to the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of the planet [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] was ordered to rendezvous with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by [[Sarin Virgilio]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] before heading to the area.<ref name="tsb" />

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] received information from an informant on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that a shipment of [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss]] [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle]]s bound for Belsavis had been stolen while the vessel they were being transported on was [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] at the Smugglers' Moon. New Republic Intelligence had no leads on who had stolen the rifles, or why they were headed to Belsavis in the first place.<ref name="NRI">{{LucasArts|url=products/outcast/html/spin.html|text=N.R.I. Reports|int=N.R.I. Reports}}</ref>

[[File:Roganda_Ismaren-crop.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Roganda Ismaren, Emperor's Hand and instigator of the Ismaren plot on Belsavis]]
However, in the same year, the former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]] began plotting to revitalize the Empire with her son, [[Irek Ismaren]]&mdash;whom she claimed was the son of Palpatine&mdash;at its head. She had been in hiding on Belsavis for seven years, instructing her son in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. With the aid of a [[subelectronic converter]], the boy was able to control machines by visualizing their schematics. Roganda Ismaren sought the support of the Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex, and used her son to reactivate the ''Eye of Palpatine'', which had lain dormant for over thirty years in the Moonflower Nebula. She hoped that the combination of the lords' wealth and the military might of the battlemoon and other weapons she had amassed over the years would rally others to their cause. However, New Republic [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her husband, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], were on Belsavis investigating rumors of the hidden Jedi enclave that Jedi Master Plett had run decades previously. Organa Solo was subsequently captured and held hostage.<ref name="CoJ" />

The ''Eye of Palpatine'', reactivated by Irek Ismaren, made its way to Belsavis. Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a pair of his [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainees]] had been captured by the automated battlemoon as it attempted to fulfill its mission parameters, which included picking up contingents of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] based on several planets. However, since thirty years had passed, the stormtroopers were either dead or gone. Undaunted, the ''Eye of Palpatine'' picked up native species from the worlds it visited, intending to complete its mission to destroy the Jedi enclave. Through separate efforts, the [[Ismaren plot]] was foiled by the Solos with the assistance of [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], while the ''Eye of Palpatine'' was destroyed when one of the Jedi students, [[Nichos Marr/Legends|Nichos Marr]], sacrificed his own life to stop the battlemoon.<ref name="CoJ" /> The Ismarens managed to escape the planet, relocating to the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]].<ref name="Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

By [[137 ABY]], the Bozhnee sector came under the authority of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-ruled [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]], which had risen to power after the Sith had manipulated the two dominant powers of the time, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Fel Empire]], into war with one another. Following the resolution of the conflict, which saw the Fel Empire defeat the Galactic Alliance, Krayt usurped the throne of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and declared himself ruler of the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
===Balinaka===
[[File:Balinak.jpg|thumb|right|100px|A Balinak]]
{{Main|Balinaka}}
The Balinaka were a species of amphibious [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] who evolved on the planet Garnib in the system of the same name. Native to an arctic planet, the Balinaka were covered in thick fur, and their amphibious nature gave them a dual [[Lung/Legends|lung]]/gill breathing system to allow them to survive on land and in [[Water/Legends|water]]. Individualistic and agreeable, Balinaka had close ties to their family and community, and their daily lives revolved around the ''[[heswe]]'', a large open area that served as a meeting place, market, and religious center. Inquisitive and curious, they were also a playful species who enjoyed the creative arts.<ref name="PoG1" /> Despite being a sentient species, some Balinaka were used as slaves by House Vandron in the Senex sector. Slave-breeding farms on the planet Karfeddion produced Balinaka slaves for use throughout the Senex-Juvex region.<ref name="CoJ" />

===Mluki===
[[File:Mluki.jpg|thumb|right|100px|Two Mluki]]
{{Main|Mluki}}
The Mluki were a species native to the planet Belsavis. They had short lifespans, growing to adolescence by the age of seven, and individuals were considered to be old by the time they had reached thirty. Mluki were hunchbacked, with their heads at the same level as their shoulders and a visible hump rising over the top of their heads. They had heavy brows on their foreheads. Mluki built settlements on Belsavis out of stone, and both farmed small areas of crops for themselves, as well as embarking on [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] expeditions out on the icy surface of their homeworld.<ref name="CoJ" />

===Ossan===
[[File:Ossan.jpg|thumb|right|100px|An Ossan]]
{{Main|Ossan}}
The Ossan were a humanoid species from the planet Ossel II in the Ossel system. They led a primitive lifestyle but had contact with the wider galaxy by trading their services aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the independent traders who visited their homeworld for syp wood. This usually meant that the Ossan would end up an indentured servant or slave, but the individuals in question believed this to be an excellent trade. Ossan fancied themselves clever negotiators, though this was usually not true. Many Ossan were released from their contracts early due to ineptitude.<ref name="GG4" /> Breeding farms of Ossan were maintained on the planet Karfeddion in the Senex sector, where House Vandron used them as slaves throughout the Senex-Juvex region.<ref name="CoJ" />

===Sibilaari===
{{Main|Sibilaari}}
The Sibilaari were a sentient [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] species that evolved on a planet in the Sibilaar system. Measuring around three meters in length, individual Sibilaari had five limbs: three on the lower part of its body, and two upper appendages. Each limb terminated in a four-fingered hand that could be used for fine manipulation. Sibilaari were black in [[Color/Legends|coloration]], and had six eyes that were arranged in a line between the two upper limbs. They had no other orifices. Sibilaari had the ability to metabolize sound to generate energy, so the areas immediately around them were completely silent. This ability also allowed them to absorb light to a limited degree, and made them sensitive to the Force. As a result, they could survive in any environment that contained either sound, light, or the Force. Their connection to the Force warned the Sibilaari about an impending threat that could have destroyed their homeworld. Lacking the technological expertise to leave the planet, they instead built shielded structures in stable parts of their world. They took shelter in these and when their world was finally destroyed, these shielded areas were flung out into space, with the Sibilaari inside them in a comatose state.<ref name="Philanthropy" />

===Srrors'tok===
[[File:Srrorstok-AE.png|thumb|right|100px|A Srrors'tok]]
{{Main|Srrors'tok}}
Native to the planet Jankok, the Srrors'tok were a bipedal [[Feline/Legends|felinoid]] race covered in a short pelt of golden fur. The structure of their mouths made it difficult for them to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], and their own language, [[Hras'kkk'rarr]], was a combination of sign language, snarls, grunts, and clicks. They preferred warm climates, and wore little clothing while in these regions, only wearing belts and pouches sufficient enough to carry tools and weapons. They were, however, susceptible to cold, and had to wear layers of clothing to survive in frigid climates. Technologically primitive, Srrors'tok lived in tribal communities, and employed an honor-bound societal structure similar to that of the Wookiees of Kashyyyk.<ref name="AE" />

===Vernol===
[[File:Vernol-AE.png|thumb|right|100px|A Vernol]]
{{Main|Vernol}}
The Vernol were a race of squat humanoids who stood 1.5 meters tall on average, and had blue skin with orange highlights that bordered their eyes and mouths. The Vernol called the planet Garnib home, although it was not their original homeworld&mdash;they emigrated to the planet approximately fifty years before the Galactic Civil War, when their own planet was rendered uninhabitable by a meteor strike. They saw Garnib as a safe place to live, and although they shared the world with the native Balinaka, the two groups rarely interacted due to the Vernol's territoriality and their tendency to be skittish and fearful. Despite this, they were adept foragers, able to find food, water, and other things that they needed wherever they went.<ref name="PoG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bozhnee sector was first mentioned in the [[1995]] short story ''[[The Saga Begins]]'', penned by [[Timothy Zahn]], which served as the lead-in to ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', published by [[West End Games]]. The sector went unreferenced until the [[2009]] publication of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the Bozhnee sector next to the Senex and Juvex sectors and located the planet Belsavis within its boundaries. Furthermore, [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|the online companion]] to the book, available at [[StarWars.com]], listed several other planets that were within the sector boundaries.
